title: Gas Safe Register UK Business Search

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: offlineTest uses synthetic fixtures without network requests. scrape walks listing and detail pages. probe is a small live diagnostic.

useUkResidentialProxy.title: Use UK residential proxy
useUkResidentialProxy.description: Enabled in the Store prefill to route requests through a UK residential proxy. Requires account entitlement; bandwidth is billed by Apify.

maxRuntimeSeconds.title: Browser runtime limit
maxRuntimeSeconds.description: Closes browser after this many seconds; also set a platform timeout.

maxNetworkRequests.title: Network request limit
maxNetworkRequests.description: Hard per-run ceiling for browser network requests, including scripts and frames. Higher values allow detail enrichment to finish but can increase proxy bandwidth and runtime.

browserProfile.title: Browser profile
browserProfile.description: The Store prefill uses Patchright Chromium, verified in limited clean-session cloud tests. Chrome and Camoufox remain alternatives; any profile can still be blocked by the source.

proxyService.title: Proxy service
proxyService.description: Residential uses bandwidth billing and a session. Unblocker uses separately billed units and does not support sticky sessions.

allowUnblockerCertificateException.title: Allow isolated Unblocker certificate exception
allowUnblockerCertificateException.description: Experimental, default off. Skips HTTPS certificate validation in one disposable browser context. All browser requests are restricted to the two exact Gas Safe HTTPS hosts. Requires a live Unblocker probe and explicit user consent.

loadPageAssets.title: Load page assets
loadPageAssets.description: Allow normal image, media and font loading during compatibility tests; proxy bandwidth may increase.

settleSeconds.title: Homepage settling time
settleSeconds.description: Allow initial page JavaScript to finish before submitting a search.

maxTransferMegabytes.title: Observed transfer limit (MB)
maxTransferMegabytes.description: Close the browser when observed CDP resource transfer exceeds this limit. In-flight resources can overshoot; not a billing cap.

proxyCountry.title: Proxy country
proxyCountry.description: GB for UK routes; AUTO lets Apify select a country.

locations.title: Towns or postcodes
locations.description: Optional list of up to ten locations; overrides location. Results share one global maxResults budget.

locationCounty.title: County for ambiguous towns
locationCounty.description: Exact county label, e.g. CAMBRIDGESHIRE. Required when multiple different towns match; full postcodes usually avoid ambiguity.

page.title: First listing page
page.description: First listing page, numbered from one.

maxPages.title: Listing pages per location
maxPages.description: Maximum consecutive listing pages per location. Random source ordering can repeat or omit businesses.

maxResults.title: Maximum unique businesses
maxResults.description: Global maximum canonical business records, deduplicated by registration number.

includeEngineers.title: Include engineers
includeEngineers.description: Visit engineer pages for each business, within the shared resource limits.

includeQualifications.title: Include qualification tables
includeQualifications.description: Visit each engineer service page and parse Domestic and Commercial tables; requires includeEngineers.

maxEngineerPages.title: Engineer pages per business
maxEngineerPages.description: Maximum engineer listing pages per business. Truncated enrichment is flagged.

maxEngineersPerBusiness.title: Engineers per business
maxEngineersPerBusiness.description: Bound on unique engineers per business. Extra engineers are explicitly marked truncated.

requestDelayMillis.title: Navigation delay (ms)
requestDelayMillis.description: Minimum delay between top-level navigations. One browser and one page at a time.

searchMethod.title: Search form compatibility
searchMethod.description: siteUi clicks Search. keyboard presses Enter. validatedForm calls the observed /tpv validation endpoint with current form state, then submits normally. nativeForm skips optional client-side validation. Source access controls still apply.
